**Owl Ears v3** - a small Windows song recogniser with an owl. One exe, nothing to install (Windows 10 / 11, 64-bit).

- **The owl** keeps watch while nothing is found: lines on the dark, amber eyes glowing with the beat of what the PC plays; while it listens its ear tufts twitch and its pupils open wide; no match: one slow blink
- **VIEW**: CLASSIC (the cover beside the song) or PICTURE (the cover large, its soft glow behind it)
- **KEEP LISTENING** every 30 s / 1 / 2 / 5 minutes
- **NOTHING FOUND**: the owl, your own picture, or a folder of pictures in turn
- Settings remembered; the history log as before

Download `OwlEars.exe` (or the zip, with the README and licences) and run it. Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher (the exe is not signed): *More info → Run anyway*.

> Unofficial: not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by Shazam or Apple; it may stop working at any time. Only the song's signature (about 1 kB of spectral peaks) leaves the PC - never the sound.
